note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after D-4 (e700fb7392), ce5c276457, 50b89fb51b, 072ef5bf1f and 516671704b changed the cited producers. RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." The same producers and the same two uncovered paths as RFC4301-5.2-1: on XFRM under the IKE engine the catch-all is installed first and removed last (applyConfig, releaseSPD, warnSPDLeft), and Ze's IKE is exempt per socket; on VPP no catch-all can be installed (CatchAllSupported answers ErrNoNodeWideSPD), and the OSPF RFC 4552 manual-key entries have no final DISCARD entry outside the IKE engine's window, the OSPF change adding removal reporting only. The gap stands.
